name: Check weekly whether Google's AI Overviews name your brand or competitors, with looot and Slack

parameters.content:
## Weekly AI visibility check in Slack

### How it works
1. Every Monday at 8, looot runs each buyer question you list through Google and reads the AI Overview, falling back to the next provider when one misses.
2. **Visibility report** checks each answer: is there an AI Overview, does it name your brand or cite your domain, and which competitors it names.
3. One Slack message shows the count of answers that mention you and a line per question.

Buyers ask Google before they ask sales. This shows which questions you are missing from.

**Cost per question per week**, from looot's public catalog on 2026-10-31: Google AI Overview $0.001 to $0.0056 depending on the provider that answers. 10 questions cost at most about $0.06 a week. Each call is capped at $0.05.

### Setup
- Needs the verified community node **n8n-nodes-looot** (built against 0.1.4): Settings > Community nodes > Install, search `looot`. [Install guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)
- looot: sign up at [looot.ai](https://looot.ai), top up (from $5), create an agent token under Settings > Agent tokens, then add a **looot API** credential in n8n.
- A Slack credential with chat:write. Set the channel ID in **Post to Slack**.
- Put your brand, domain, competitors and questions in **Brand and questions**.

### Customization
Write each week's result to Google Sheets to chart the trend. Add questions from your sales calls.

## One question per call
Edit brand, competitors and questions.

## Named, cited or missing
One Slack message a week.
